--- title: Lazy pipelines description: Use polars-umap in LazyFrame queries, from scan to sink. jupyter: python3 bread-crumbs: false --- Everything in polars-umap works in lazy mode. The output schema is known up front, so you can build and inspect a query before running it. ::: {#450a337e .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} import polars_umap # noqa: F401 query = ( pl.scan_parquet(path) .filter(pl.col("lang") == "en") .umap.fit_transform("embedding", metric="cosine", random_state=0) .drop("embedding") ) query.collect_schema() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` Schema([('id', Int64), ('lang', String), ('umap_0', Float32), ('umap_1', Float32)]) ``` ::: ::: ::: {#5bd08342 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} print(query.explain()) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` simple π 4/4 ["id", "lang", "umap_0", ... 1 other column] WITH_COLUMNS: [col("__polars_umap_embedding__").arr.get([dyn int: 0]).alias("umap_0"), col("__polars_umap_embedding__").arr.get([dyn int: 1]).alias("umap_1")] simple π 3/3 ["id", "lang", ... 1 other column] WITH_COLUMNS: [col("embedding")./Users/jeroen/repos/mine/polars-umap/python/polars_umap/_internal.abi3.so:umap_fit_transform().alias("__polars_umap_embedding__")] Parquet SCAN [/var/folders/_l/x6n0w90j54790nrdcb5hfzj40000gp/T/tmpoaypdpsr/embeddings.parquet] PROJECT */3 COLUMNS SELECTION: col("lang") == "en" ESTIMATED ROWS: 5000 ``` ::: ::: The filter runs before UMAP, so only the English rows are embedded. Collect the query, or sink it to a file: ::: {#484b063c .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} query.collect().head(3) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=4} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: ```python query.sink_parquet("projected.parquet") ``` ## Things to keep in mind - **UMAP needs all rows at once.** It isn't elementwise: the embedding of each row depends on all the others. Polars therefore materializes the input column before calling polars-umap, even in the streaming engine. Filter and select early so that only what's needed is loaded. - **Filters change the result.** Filtering before UMAP fits a different model than filtering after it. That's usually what you want, but it's worth being deliberate about.
